# Journal

> Journal is an open source (AGPL-3.0), local-first notebook on your own Homebase identity. Notes live in a database in your browser, work offline, and sync encrypted to your identity. You can share notes with people and circles, publish public pages, write live Mermaid, SVG, HTML and React blocks, and let AI agents read and write the folders you grant through the Journal MCP server.

Journal runs in the browser and signs in with a Homebase identity. The web app is free, with every feature. Journal+, the native apps for iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and Linux, is coming soon: a 3-day trial, then €24.99 once for a license key that works on up to 5 devices, with a year of updates.

## App

- [Open Journal](https://journal.cloudx.run/welcome): the web app, installable as a PWA
- [Home](https://journal.cloudx.run/): what Journal is, where notes live, the editor, sharing, live blocks and common questions
- [Pricing](https://journal.cloudx.run/landing/pricing): the free web app and the paid native apps
- [Journal+](https://journal.cloudx.run/landing/buy): the native apps, the license key and renewing updates
- [Contact](https://journal.cloudx.run/landing/contact): how to reach us, and support for the web app and the native apps
- [Privacy](https://journal.cloudx.run/landing/privacy): what Journal stores, where, and what it never collects

## Agents

- [Agents](https://journal.cloudx.run/landing/agents): set up the Journal MCP server in Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor or Codex CLI, and the reference for every tool
- [MCP server README](https://github.com/2002Bishwajeet/journal/blob/main/mcp/README.md): setup for each client, headless sign-in, and every tool
- [Authoring guide](https://github.com/2002Bishwajeet/journal/blob/main/mcp/AUTHORING.md): everything a note can hold and how to write it, including live blocks
